context:
Goal: PR #3264 gets its round 1 review record at its current head, so it can be handed in.
Problem (rule): your 774 b let the lane run the record command for PR #3264 unwrapped, as the settings entry "Merge Tool Read Checks" names it. The item showed the command with head 85824b473. The lane's item 773 a work moved the head to e93b1eff3 (round 1 PASS), so the same command now has a different head. The coordinator and I read a grant as covering the act it names, never a variant, so I cannot extend it without your word.
Based on (ruling): own-774-b-record-form-grant (its text says "that command form for that PR only" and quotes the old head); the lane's report via the coordinator, unchecked by triage.
Departs from: main — the classifier denies the lane's record command today; a lets the same form run for any head of #3264, b only for the old head.
Meanwhile: the lane waits; its hand-in waits for #3314 on main anyway.
